description: Airport reference data. Use when a task needs the static facts about an airport: what an IATA or ICAO code means, where the airport is (city, region, country, coordinates, elevation), whether it has scheduled airline service, which airports a country has, or the straight-line distance and initial bearing between two of them. Cost: 1 credit per call.

code.description: One IATA (LHR) or ICAO (EGLL) code. Returns that single airport. Cannot be combined with q, country or from/to.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Returns that country's airports as a list.

from.description: Origin IATA or ICAO code for a distance query. Must be sent with to.

limit.description: Page size for a q or country list.

offset.description: Rows to skip for a q or country list.

q.description: Free-text search over airport, city and code. Returns a list.

to.description: Destination IATA or ICAO code. Must be sent with from.

type.description: Filters a q or country list by airport size. Refused on a code or from/to query, which have no list to shape.

name: airports
